about: One test vector for Space.digest(): the program, the canonical lines engine/filereader/source_lifecycle.pl's metta_host_digest_line/2 writes for its atoms in multiset-sorted order, and the sha256 of those lines joined by newlines as UTF-8. Every seat that answers digest() runs this program and must answer this hex. Regenerate deliberately: a change here is a change to what two spaces holding the same atoms agree on.
program:
(user 1 ada)
(user 2 bob)
(w-empty ())
(numbers -3.5 42 0)
(text "say \"hi\"" "back\\slash")
(flags True False)
(= (double $x) (* $x 2))
(nested (inner a) (inner b))
